note: Create Room demo storyboard (lane E). Each segment: what is shown, its honesty label(s), and the spoken lines. Voices are Kokoro int8 v0.19 speakers from CHE's local voice catalog (lib/che_native_voice.dart): CHE = 0 'af' (Chaze signature) at speed 0.94; the owner's words are RE-ENACTED with speaker 6 'am_michael' (not the owner's voice); Ava's voices are 3 'af_sarah' and 7 'bf_emma'. lines.text: CHE's Create Room, demonstrated. Each part is labelled real, prototype, or not possible at zero cost.
Create Ava: a fictional woman in her thirties, warm brown skin, dark hair, terracotta top. All three styles.
Creating Ava in three styles on the free CPU worker.
Ava is ready in three styles. One, photoreal. Two, game-like. Three, stylized. Say a number to choose.
Show her skeleton.
Skeleton shown. Fifty-three bones with skin weights, five animation clips, and five facial shape keys.
Her face: a blink, a smile, raised brows, and an open mouth. These are her own shape keys.
Walk, turn around, run, then wave.
Walking.
Turning.
Running.
Waving.
Let her speak.
Hi, I'm Ava. My mouth follows this voice, generated on this machine, for free.
Make her hair copper, change the outfit to blue, and make her taller and stronger.
Done. All three kept the same fifty-three bones and five clips, so every animation still plays.
Try another voice.
This is voice seven, from CHE's free local voice list.
Put her in my office. Walk to the desk, sit down, and point at the screen.
Ava is walking to the desk.
Sitting, and gesturing at the screen.
Save her, then open My Creations.
Saved. Opening Ava from My Creations in Live Studio. Exports: a G L B file, and a Roblox R fifteen F B X.
That is the Create Room today. The labels show what is real now, and what is still planned.
